_comment: x402 paywall pricing per endpoint. Values are in microUSDC (1e6 == $1). Hot-reloadable: changes take effect on next request. Contract documented in docs/services/x402_as_a_service.md §6. v2 (CAIP-2 networks + PAYMENT-* headers, v1 X-PAYMENT fallback).

free_quota._comment: Per-wallet free-call allowance on cost-center endpoints. Resets every 24h rolling window. Anonymous callers get 0 free calls (must pay every time).

/coordinator/backlog/process.description: Pops + processes one item, may chain calls

/agents/{agent_id}/evolve.description: Full directive loop, up to N LLM calls

/permaweb/upload.description: Permanent Arweave storage (Turbo fulfillment desk); uploads <=100 KiB are free of credits but the gate still applies

/dato/join.description: Request-to-join a DAIO-owned dato (data-DAO); per-dato join fee. Modular extension — see dato/ (advertised price; only active once dato is governance-included)

/reference/file.description: Reference corpus file read — x402 file-system privilege from payment (WISDOM model). Privilege (OVERSEER/OVERLORD JWT, session, or API key) bypasses; otherwise a 402 settlement grants the `paid` tier read-access.

_endpoints_note: Removed orphaned /llm/chat, /llm/completion, /bankon/identity/provision in v2.0.0 — those routes do not exist (real LLM routes live under /api/llm/*). Re-add when the routes ship.

base._comment: USDC on Base. EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization. Default fastest-cheapest EVM rail.
base._payTo_note: bankon.eth fee recipient (direct collection; swap to BankonPaymentRouter once deployed).

tempo._comment: USDC.e on Tempo. Multi-Party Payment chain. Used when settlement requires more than one signer (e.g. DAO-controlled treasury).
tempo._payTo_note: Tempo USDC.e contract + payee address pending Tempo mainnet deploy.

algorand-mainnet._comment: USDC ASA on Algorand Mainnet (Parsec / GoPlausible exact AVM scheme). Sub-second finality, atomic-group fee abstraction. Non-EVM rail.
algorand-mainnet._payTo_note: mindx.algo (OVERSEER). MUST be opted in to USDC ASA 31566704 to settle.

algorand-testnet._comment: USDC ASA on Algorand TestNet (Parsec exact AVM scheme). For integration testing.
algorand-testnet._payTo_note: mindx.algo (testnet). Must be opted in to testnet USDC ASA 10458941.

facilitator._comment: mindX-hosted facilitator. Callers may verify with any compatible facilitator and present the proof; mindX re-verifies on-chain before honoring it.

idempotency._comment: Verified settlements are cached for 60s so a network retry (same X-PAYMENT) within the window does not double-charge.
